eventPipeline.producer: The four Anchor programs emit Anchor events (emit!) into transaction logs.
eventPipeline.indexer: backend/src/{listen,backfill,ingest}.ts — one onLogs websocket per program (push) + historical getSignaturesForAddress walk (pull/backfill) + periodic heal passes. Read-only: no signer, no admin, no writes to the chain. Same ingestTx also handles Helius enhanced-webhook payloads (docs/03 §3.1).
eventPipeline.storage: SQLite events_raw (node:sqlite), dedup UNIQUE(signature, ix_index, event_index); projections rebuilt purely from events_raw (npm run backend:rebuild).
eventPipeline.cursors: indexer_cursor per program: newest_signature / newest_slot / history_complete (history_complete stays 0 while any listed signature could not be fetched — indexer_gaps records them, repairIndexerGaps retries, SEC-B27).
eventPipeline.finality: projections applied at `confirmed`; finality reconciler stamps events_raw.finalized_at via getSignatureStatuses and DELETES events of fork-dropped txs (backend/src/finality.ts, SEC-M5). Value-bearing endpoints require finalized.
eventPipeline.readApis: GET /wallet/{address}/events (raw indexed events, openapi.yaml), /stats, /admin/kpi — served by the backend API (default port 8787). WebSocket /ws is a client cache-invalidation protocol (backend/src/wire.ts), NOT a telemetry feed.
eventPipeline.exporterForHub: No dedicated Watchtower exporter exists. The former scripts/watchtower_v3_server.py was a CONTRACT MOCK with hardcoded synthetic sample events and WRONG program ids — it was DELETED on 2026-10-06 together with its registry, CLI (handoff-v3.*) and mock tests. The real read path today is the backend indexer DB/API; a hub-facing exporter (push to POST /api/ingest/solana or pull endpoint) is the agreed next step.
